Timeline audio
==============
Sound off the open Resolve timeline. Press "Grab the audio" on the node —
nothing happens when the workflow runs, so you can iterate against the
same take.

what
----
  the clip at the playhead   just that one clip. Usually what you want,
                             and it takes about a second.
  the whole timeline         every audio track mixed into one. Right for
                             transcribing an edit, wrong for feeding a
                             model, which then gets music and dialogue
                             at once.
  a clip by index            clip number `clip_index` on track `track`.

track 0 means whichever enabled audio track has a clip under the
playhead, A1 first.

The waveform drawn on the node is there so you can see at a glance that
you did not grab silence.

Models needed
-------------
None. This one only talks to DaVinci Resolve.
